CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `acs_perfil_microarea` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `cnes` varchar(7),
  `ine` varchar(10),
  `nomeAcs` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `cnsAcs` varchar(15),
  `idadeAcs` int,
  `anosExperiencia` int DEFAULT 0,
  `latDomicilio` decimal(10, 8),
  `lngDomicilio` decimal(11, 8),
  `capacidadeMaxFamilias` int DEFAULT 450,
  `capacidadeMaxCidadaos` int DEFAULT 750,
  `ativo` boolean DEFAULT true,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `acs_perfil_microarea_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `microareas` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `nome` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `codigo` varchar(20),
  `acsId` int,
  `cnes` varchar(7),
  `ine` varchar(10),
  `geojsonPoligono` text,
  `cor` varchar(7) DEFAULT '#3B82F6',
  `totalFamilias` int DEFAULT 0,
  `totalCidadaos` int DEFAULT 0,
  `areaKm2` decimal(10, 4),
  `status` enum('ativa','inativa','excesso','baixa_cobertura') DEFAULT 'ativa',
  `geradaAutomaticamente` boolean DEFAULT false,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `microareas_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `microareas_acsId_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`acsId`) REFERENCES `acs_perfil_microarea`(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `domicilios_microarea` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `microareaId` int,
  `coFamilia` varchar(20),
  `coProntuario` varchar(20),
  `nomeResponsavel` varchar(255),
  `endereco` text,
  `numero` varchar(20),
  `complemento` varchar(100),
  `bairro` varchar(100),
  `cep` varchar(9),
  `lat` decimal(10, 8),
  `lng` decimal(11, 8),
  `geocodificado` boolean DEFAULT false,
  `geocodificadoEm` timestamp,
  `totalCidadaos` int DEFAULT 1,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `domicilios_microarea_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `domicilios_microarea_microareaId_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`microareaId`) REFERENCES `microareas`(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `microarea_historico` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `microareaId` int NOT NULL,
  `acao` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `descricao` text,
  `usuarioId` int,
  `dadosAnteriores` text,
  `dadosNovos` text,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  CONSTRAINT `microarea_historico_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `microarea_historico_microareaId_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`microareaId`) REFERENCES `microareas`(`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `microarea_historico_usuarioId_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`usuarioId`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`)
);
